title: Los Alamos tiger team security test failed

tellings.quote: they called it the tiger team came in to test security there, and they failed so horribly

plain: Around 1990 or 1991, a tiger team, a group sent in to test security by trying to get past it, came to the Los Alamos nuclear weapons laboratory in New Mexico, and according to the guest Bob Lazar the lab's security "failed so horribly." Lazar tells Michels this as something he was told, and it would mean one of the country's most secret sites was far easier to get into than it should have been.
